title: Paid and taken
story: Asha asks for her usual milk and bread. The Guard allows it, and ShopBot pays. The Payment is scheduled first, and shortly after it is captured: the money is taken. A Decision and a Payment are separate things, and the Guard tracks both.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Milk and bread at FreshMart come to INR 800. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled with the bank. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

what_to_notice: Watch the Payment's status: create_payment answers scheduled, and get_payment later answers captured, once the pretend bank settles the debit. The allow is a Decision with its own Audit record; the Payment is a second record that points at it, and it can only be made once per Decision.
